builds.notes: Deployed from Harlem's Workspace (Webflow Cloud app savebrew-site, branch main, mount /, custom domain not attached; site access set to Everyone in the Workspace can view on 2026-09-26). Repo pushed folder by folder through GitHub web upload in Chrome (the sandbox has no GitHub credentials); later fixes went through a branch and one squash merged PR so a single build deploys. The sixteen Higgsfield renders were pulled through the desktop browser because the CDN is outside the sandbox allowlist. Post deploy live QA found: two mobile reveal defects the pre deploy QA missed (the Terms columns and the membership cards at 375 never met a 15 percent reveal threshold on sections six and seven viewports tall) and a first paint blink on every route, fixed by gating all 58 entrance hidden states on html.sb-motion and revealing tall sections on their first pixel; then, between 900 and 1279 wide, the loom docking its threads onto the wrapped columns of the collapsed pass grid (threads missed the knot labels), an orphaned H1 line with a leading space, and the 16:10 poster fitted by height and cropping the outer threads (up to 290px off the labels under reduced motion), fixed in c224258 (dock on the hero knot centres when collapsed, H1 inline with balanced wrap under 1200, four poster framings by aspect ratio: worst thread offset now under 30px from 900x900 to 3440x1440, one framing fetched per viewport). 782762a changed three labels after the Step 8 sameness re check. Verified on the production build of each commit: 0 hidden frames on the first viewport blink probe across 12 routes at 1440 and 375, the tall section probe clean, buy path 50 of 50; live: every route 200 with its own title, the 301 aliases, the designed 404 with a 404 status, LCP 672 ms, CLS 0.030, the loom 60 fps average and 56.8 fps minimum through the signature scroll. The hero screenshot was captured from the production build of the deployed commit at 1440 by 900 because the browser window on the user's machine is occluded (a hidden tab freezes requestAnimationFrame, so a live capture shows a stale frame). Placeholders left for Harlem: [EIN Address] and [INSERT SHORT CODE] on /terms and /privacy; the footer and Contact carry the real address from Asana. 2026-09-28: e7d3fdd (PR #2) removed the wide width voids found by the ragged height scan (see full_page_rule) and brought the Roundup's text inside 28 to 55 characters a line; buy path 50 of 50 and the blink and tall section probes clean on that build. 08506fe (PR #3): the Guides board has no ragged lane at any width (see full_page_rule); the Coupons and Paycheck pass items carry two new kit graphics (public/assets/kit/pass-graphics, drawn by assets/build_pass_graphics.py in the kit's thread language) and qa/void-check.mjs is in the site repo; live on 2026-09-28 with every route 200, the designed 404 at 404 and both feeds 200. 24ccda1 (PR #4): no lone phone beside the dashboard on the home page and /membership, each product view marks its own tab, the home free board and the Roundup past row read in source order, and qa/hfill-check.mjs and qa/order-check.mjs are in the site repo; live on 2026-09-28.

builds.notes: No max width containers anywhere; every section spans edge to edge at 1440, 1920 and 2560 (Harlem's negative space rule), verified by gutter_check at 60 of 60 route and width checks.

builds.archetype: Full-Bleed Cinematic Hero (cast as the standing month: a rendered world filling the viewport under centered type)
builds.governing_idea: One month on the kitchen wall: every bill stands on its day, the light moves across the counter, and the heads-up arrives before the day does.

signature_world.object: a standing month: a wall calendar page laid on a kitchen counter with paper bill tags standing on their due dates and a phone at the frame edge
signature_world.camera_path: pull back from one day cell to the whole standing month, then a time-lapse light sweep across the days while bills land on their dates and one heads-up lifts into the phone, settling to an elevated reading angle

palette.color_story: cream and graphite with one marigold highlighter

builds.motif: the day cell with a standing tag (SVG square, graphite border, date numeral, paper tag with ink stripe over a soft shadow) plus the heads-up arc
builds.loader_transition: flip calendar: the day card flips from the 1st to today's date in step with real load, then flips into the hero month as today's marker
builds.nav_style: calendar header: cream row, Fraunces wordmark top left, horizontal Figtree links with a hollow day-cell square sliding under the active link, paper-tag cart top right, condenses to 56px on scroll
builds.button_style: paper tag: marigold rounded rectangle with a folded corner, graphite Figtree label, lifts onto shadow-2 with a sliding label on hover, flattens on press, idle shadow breathing
builds.typographic_set_piece: The Settled Numeral: the oversized due date 2 in Fraunces starts at WONK 1 / SOFT 100 like a date circled by hand and settles to WONK 0 with opsz sharpening as the pull-back completes
builds.interactive_feature: builder: Build your month at /builder (add 3 to 5 bills, they land on a live month with reminder arcs, result recommends a plan with the purchase CTA)

builds.archetype: Sticky-Stacked Cards Narrative, cast as Five Shops (one pinned stage of 1.5vh carries the frame sequence edge to edge while five full width shop cards deal over it and stack like a deck, then the stack folds into How it decided and the page releases into full width sections; stage is the viewport at every size, gutter clamp(16px, 3.5vw, 88px), auto fit grids below)
builds.governing_idea: One light on: the phone's own cool glow finds the card to tap, and everything else in the wallet goes dark.

signature_world.object: five generic card tiles standing upright on black glass on an oxblood leather counter, a phone propped on a small stand in front of them whose cool screen glow is the only light, and a small sign above the cards that changes shop
signature_world.camera_path: one slow half orbit (about 110 degrees at tabletop height) around the standing cards while the sign cycles five shops and the propped phone turns so its cool glow walks to the card that earns most at each; the cards never move, only the light and the sign change; ends with the glow resting on Everyday 4% at the cafe (The Last Light)

palette.accent_hue_family: ice white (cool screen light, used as a metallic)
palette.color_story: oxblood leather with one cool light on

builds.body_font: Familjen Grotesk with Instrument Serif for the answer line only
builds.motif: the lit card on glass: a card tile in a pool of cool light with its reflection; Pass seal with five arcs; dividers the pool, five on glass, the glass edge; twelve icons in warm grey with ice white for the recommended one; Familjen tabular numerals
builds.loader_transition: the five shops index: the five shop names list as chapters and each gains a small card mark as its frames land, then the list slides into place as the page's sticky chapter index while the poster crossfades to frame one; nothing lights with load, no Flip; 1.6s target, 4s cap, Skip, copy readable at 0.7s
builds.nav_style: the usher's strip: oxblood band, Familjen wordmark top left, horizontal links where only the active link sits at full white and the rest at 60 percent with nothing beneath any link, card outline cart top right with count, glass tile Buy Pass at far right unrimmed until the hero button scrolls past, thins to 56px on scroll
builds.button_style: the glass tile: card shaped button radius 12 in dark glass (surface 2 at 85 percent, 8px backdrop blur) with a 1px ice white inner rim and ice white label; a band of cool light passes once across the face on hover; the face darkens for a frame on press; the band passes every 7s at idle; no fill, no halo, no breathing; secondary buttons drop the rim and use a warm grey label
builds.typographic_set_piece: The Last Light: at the cafe the glow feints toward Grocery 6% then swings to Everyday 4% and the answer fades up from black letter by letter in Instrument Serif, the only serif on the site
builds.interactive_feature: quiz: Three questions, one light at /quiz (nav label Find your plan): cards carried, where spending goes, rotating category habit; the light walks to Free, Pass or Pass Family with the reason and the till answer; purchase button on the result
builds.engine_profile: baseline-r128 (Three.js only for the lightweight per page scroll scenes; the Home signature is a scrubbed frame sequence)
invented_techniques: The Light Walks: a scroll scrubbed photoreal still life whose light is the product's own screen, with DOM shop cards stacking over it and a Flip free loader handoff into the page's own chapter index

builds.archetype: Split-Screen Diptych (cast as The Two Shores)
builds.governing_idea: Two shores and a level: every page is paired halves meeting at a drawn water line; the signature world is a cove at slack water where one expense cleaves into two shares that moor on opposite shores and the water settles level

signature_world.object: a cove at slack water: two slate headlands with mooring posts and iris lanterns, a still water plane with faked mirror reflections and a swell, one white expense tablet that cleaves into two shares
signature_world.camera_path: pendulum arc in one vertical plane from a grazing mirror view at the near shore, up and over the cleave to a plan view, the water flipping from pale mirror to slate depth, ending in a full fade handoff into the DOM water line

palette.color_story: cold morning water: mist field, slate ink, receipt paper warmth on the one object, one iris lantern

builds.motif: the Level: a water line drawn in from both shores meeting at a seam with one float above it
builds.loader_transition: fog lift with the line meeting: a mist veil thins with real load while one hairline draws in from both edges and meets, then Flips into the hero water line
builds.nav_style: mooring line nav: sentence case links resting on one full width hairline with an iris float that slides to the hovered or active route; cart as a hairline ring; fixed opaque header that never shrinks
builds.button_style: the float: capsule cut flat on one end (radius 999 left, 0 right), iris fill, hover grows a mooring hairline from the flat end and bobs the label, press ripples
builds.typographic_set_piece: The Cleave: the sentence 'Every expense, split the way you both agreed.' splits at the comma on scroll, halves widening on the Bricolage width axis to the margins with a share figure beneath each
builds.interactive_feature: sorter (Sort a month: flick twelve household items to a shore, the ledger answers live, plan recommended)
invented_techniques: The Cleave and Moor (signature world with faked mirror reflection recipe)
The Two Shores (casting of Split-Screen Diptych)

builds.archetype: Illustrated Scroll World, cast as Walking Home (the rendered lot at dusk fills the viewport edge to edge at every width; type docks in a calm reading measure with the world doing the visual work at both sides; the five windows double as always visible progress)
builds.governing_idea: Lights on: an estate plan is a house at dusk where every window comes on as a step is finished, and the plan is done when all five are lit and the property line closes around the lot in the colour of the last light, because a trust controls only what it owns.

signature_world.object: a household at dusk: a linen house on its lot whose rooms brighten together on a dimmer as the reader scrolls, a porch light that is on from the overture, and a property line that closes around the lot in the rose of the last light, all drawn by one raymarched program (The Dusk Lot)
signature_world.camera_path: a held shot from across the street: the camera rests on a three quarter view of the whole lot, walks past by three metres and leans in six percent over the scroll with a hand held sway from the pointer; the world moves instead: the porch light is on from the overture, every room comes up together on one continuous dimmer as the reader scrolls, and in the last chapter the survey line draws itself closed around the lot in rose

palette.color_story: last light: dusk plum field, lamplit linen rooms and one rose

builds.motif: the lit window (rounded 3:4 rectangle, thin linen frame, cross mullion, panes filling with lamp light) joined by the property line, a hairline loop with surveyor ticks that draws itself closed
builds.loader_transition: porch light overture: the dusk sky deepens and the house mark's five lights come on in step with real load stages, the fifth in rose; then the porch light's glow swells until lamp light fills the screen and contracts onto the porch lamp of the rendered house, the loader sky already the scene sky (no Flip)
builds.nav_style: porch header: translucent dusk plum bar, single stroke house mark and Young Serif wordmark top left, horizontal Hanken Grotesk links; a small pendant lamp hangs from the bar's top edge above the active link and casts a cone of lamp light down onto it, sliding along the bar to a hovered link and returning; five lights progress strip on step pages, bag cart top right, thins to 56px on scroll
builds.button_style: the lit window: soft rounded rectangle (10px), rose fill with a faint linen frame and dusk plum label; on hover a lamp comes up behind the panes and the frame brightens; on press the light dips for a beat like a switch; at idle a filament settles in irregular steps, never a breath; no lift, no flatten; secondary is the dark window, linen outline
builds.typographic_set_piece: Lights On, the five line stack: five Young Serif lines, one per step, each rising from behind its own sill mask and warming from dim mauve to linen as its chapter arrives, the fifth settling in rose with the DONE check docking at its end
builds.interactive_feature: finder: Check your state at /state-check (state, plan, one or two people, home ownership, optional county) returning remote signing availability, what the session covers and who may witness, the recording and notary fee picture, what is charged today, and a Purchase the plan button
builds.hero_composition: the rendered lot at dusk fills the first viewport edge to edge on a held three quarter view from across the street; the house stands centre with the survey line and the front walk running to both edges; the H1 stands in a centred reading measure at the foot of the viewport with the world on both sides; the rooms are dim at the top and brighten on a dimmer as the reader scrolls
builds.seal_form: a gable plate: a five sided house end wall with the mark in the gable, SAVE THE WILL on the lintel band and SIGNED, NOTARIZED, FUNDED on the sill line (no ring, no circular text)

builds.archetype: Split-Screen Diptych (cast as the Two-Source Diptych)
builds.governing_idea: Turn it over: every record in a claim file has a front, what it asserts, and a reverse, what it actually carries, and Logifx lays the two sides beside each other so the conflict is something you see, not something you are told.

signature_world.object: a single photographic print from the claim file (Photo 07, a creased quarter panel in a body shop bay) hanging in a baize void, with its metadata etched on the reverse
signature_world.camera_path: frontal hold while the print turns 90 degrees to edge on, continue to 180 for the reverse side, then a straight fly through the conflict ring to the far side where the field inverts to ash and the other four exhibits stand already turned

palette.color_story: green baize and silver, an analogous green two field system with one carmine ring for the conflict

builds.body_font: Instrument Sans (words) with Martian Mono (citations and metadata)
builds.motif: the ring at the seam: a seam bisecting a ring, two ticks that stop short; fills to a disc when the sides agree, collapses to a grey square when a source is silent
builds.loader_transition: latent image loader: the wordmark and the claims investigation descriptor develop from a faint grey ghost to full silver in the right half of the diptych in step with real load, then the developed plate turns edge on and hands off into the hero print's first frame
builds.nav_style: spine header: transparent over the hero, gains a baize plate with a silver hairline and a 4px edge on scroll, wordmark plus claims investigation descriptor top left, horizontal two sided link plates that turn on their vertical axis on hover to show an italic serif reverse, active link held on its reverse, a seam tick at the exact centre, cart plate top right
builds.button_style: extruded silver plate: solid silver rectangle with radius 2 and a 4px ash edge, deep baize sans label, tilts up to 6 degrees toward the pointer and lifts as the edge grows on hover, flattens onto its edge on press, a 1px light travels the edge at idle, ring focus
builds.typographic_set_piece: The Turned Word: the H1 phrase 'disagrees with itself' turns word by word on its vertical axis to its italic reverse carrying the citation that proves it; the same turn is the Home text hover treatment
builds.interactive_feature: examination: Examine a file at /examine (choose the auto or property sample file, turn over the six source exhibit cards to include them, toggle the fourteen facts; the matrix fills with discs, rings and squares, conflicts appear only when both disagreeing sources are included, the complexity and turnaround lines compute, Purchase Platform on the result)
invented_techniques: The Reverse Side (two faced WebGL print turning under scrub with a fly through and field inversion)

builds.archetype: Road Book (invented: a rally road book descent: one film print per section set on a fixed six column hairline grid, each print followed by a paper field holding one statement, the dirt road passing between prints from top to bottom)

signature_world.object: a debadged vintage Land Cruiser parked at a snowy trailhead in the mountain West with a modern skier beside it heading for the peak, printed first as a warm silver gelatin black and white photograph
signature_world.camera_path: slow push in toward the skier while the black and white print develops into disposable camera colour from the sky downward, a held beat as the skier's next stride lands in full colour, then the ski track in the foreground snow narrows into the dirt road that leads down into The vehicles we rebuild and the photograph unpins and scrolls away

builds.signature_move_id: MOT-017 (invented: The Develop, a black and white to film colour push in on the hero photograph)

palette.color_story: restoration film: warm silver gelatin black and white that develops into faded disposable camera colour by scroll depth, on warm paper, with one mustard accent

builds.motif: the dirt road: two wavering wheel ruts with a broken tuft line between them, drawn as an SVG that bends down from the end of one section to the start of the next and draws on with scroll
builds.loader_transition: film leader: a strip of 35mm leader with sprocket holes runs along the top edge of the already painted black and white hero, advancing one frame per real asset stage, then winds off the right edge at ready; skip from 0s, 1.6s target, 4s cap
builds.nav_style: dashboard placard nav: a paper band with the Duncrest wordmark top left, horizontal Work Sans links set like engraved placard labels, the active link framed by four viewfinder corner marks like a disposable camera's frame guide, Start your build in mustard at top right in place of a cart, the band's ink warming from silver to film amber as the page develops
builds.button_style: the dash toggle: a mustard rectangle with a small period toggle lever at its left end that throws down on hover while the label shifts right 3px, a 2px press like a dash switch on click, the arrow glyph rolls forward once like a wheel turning every 10s at idle; secondary is an ink hairline outline
builds.typographic_set_piece: Two Words, Equal Weight: in the powertrain section CRATE and ELECTRIC are set at the same huge Cormorant caps size side by side, each letterform filled with a film photograph of a vehicle being driven, and both fills develop from black and white into colour at the same moment as the section crosses the viewport
builds.interactive_feature: configurator (Draft your build sheet at /build-sheet: vehicle, build level, powertrain, own vehicle or donor search, how it will be driven; a draft build sheet fills in and develops into colour line by line, lists what that level includes from the comparison table and the from $100,000 floor, and ends on Start your build, prefilled)
